scope: Concept coverage and migration requirements. No runtime hero replacement, stat edits or save/replay aliasing.

rating_rules.exact conceptual replacement: Explicitly reviewed matching fantasy plus matching unordered branch pair; never numeric or implementation parity.
rating_rules.strong match: Direct role/mechanic-family counterpart with a documented conceptual difference.
rating_rules.partial match: At least one shared branch or explicit complementary coverage; preserves only part of the oracle need.
rating_rules.no match: No shared branch and no explicit reviewed counterpart; not suitable as direct concept mapping.

oracles.preservation_requirement: Rage/Power flame-pressure fantasy; burn timing, resource use and all existing stats stay in the oracle fixture.
oracles.merge_split: Single conceptual replacement; no data transfer.
oracles.runtime_action: retain original oracle ID, stats, skills and replay fixtures until a separately versioned gameplay migration passes parity
